servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Inspection

item.ptxt: Check accessory drive belt (4) when engine is cool and the belt is dry.

It is not possible to check the accessory drive belt length by observing the alignment of the slit (1) on auto tensioner (2) and “
” mark (3) on timing chain cover.
If the check result is not OK even though the accessory drive belt is replaced with a new one, replace the auto tensioner.

servinfo.ptxt: Check the following points. If check result is not OK, replace accessory drive belt.

item.ptxt: Check accessory drive belt for crack, tear, deformation, wear or dirt.
When engine is idling or racing, check that there is noise from accessory drive belt.
